deferredForEditableCoding.sourcePlacement: Under `### Wallet recovery and seed phrase testing`, after the six numbered recovery-readiness steps and before “The point is not to make recovery feel easy”.
deferredForEditableCoding.instructionalRelationship: Turns the recovery text into a safe sequence a learner can rehearse.
deferredForEditableCoding.allRequiredTextConnectorsAndPlacementIns: Follow the six current steps: use official instructions for the exact training wallet; confirm compatibility; work privately; use the approved backup-check or recovery method; confirm expected receiving information or training history; reset or clear the temporary environment. Use only prepared, empty, or simulated materials. Put `educator never sees the secret` outside every step. Do not instruct learners to erase a wallet before verifying its backup or introduce real funds.
